easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Tap Spider-Gwen using any free method.
Spider-Gwen triggers, causing you to rummage.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
